SELECT LEVEL, C.ONETALK_NO, C.ONETALK_CONTENT, C.ONETALK_DEL_FL, C.ONETALK_WRITE_DATE, C.MEMBER_NO, C.WORKER_NICKNAME, C.MEMBER_NAME, C.PARENT_ONETALK_NO FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ONETALK_NO, ONETALK_CONTENT, ONETALK_DEL_FL,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - ONETALK_WRITE_DATE < 1/24/60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - ONETALK_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전' WHEN SYSDATE - ONETALK_WRITE_DATE < 1/24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - ONETALK_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전' WHEN SYSDATE - ONETALK_WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - ONETALK_WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전' ELSE TO_CHAR(ONETALK_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END ONETALK_WRITE_DATE,
MEMBER_NO, WORKER_NICKNAME, MEMBER_NAME, PARENT_ONETALK_NO FROM "ONETALK" LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "WORKER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" USING(MEMBER_NO) ) C WHERE (ONETALK_DEL_FL = 'N' OR 0 != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ONETALK" SUB WHERE SUB.PARENT_ONETALK_NO = C.ONETALK_NO AND ONETALK_DEL_FL = 'N')) START WITH PARENT_ONETALK_NO IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR ONETALK_NO = PARENT_ONETALK_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY ONETALK_NO DESC
